semantics: Lambda Blotto is discrete Colonel Blotto. Delta is its operational semantics. File observe-run-seal transitions supply explicit evidence effects to that integrated model.
lambda_role: Lambda denotes spectral coordinates together with lambda-calculus motion in the integrated discrete Colonel Blotto semantics.
active_graph_machine: Sparky is the active approximately-20K-file greenfield stateless graph machine before Phoenix, not an inspiration corpus.
provenance_contract: Every request carries source-root, root-key, mapping identity, revision reference, full map-to-target drilldown chain, source kind/family/identity, claim key, volume/chapter/appendix routing, an immutable tuple of exact corpus route occurrences, and evidence class. Each occurrence seals exact text, path, locus, revision, frame time, authority scope, resolution status, non-exclusivity, relation, classification, support boundary, target volume/chapter/subsection, semantic drill-down, diagram route, citation key, publication header/footer state, and readback artifact. Observed, Predicted, Counterfactual, and Admitted are non-interchangeable lineages.

corpus_routing_contract.canonical_topology: OUR ecosystem -> PHOENIX RUN [contains Molt D/R] -> Icarus -> Helios/GraphAtlas
corpus_routing_contract.mechanism: Molt is the disintegration/reassimilation mechanism inside PHOENIX RUN.
corpus_routing_contract.icarus_role: getting-to-the-sun vehicle, custom VS Code/Protege ecosystem integration, named reborn integration state, Daedalus implicated
corpus_routing_contract.helios_graphatlas_role: mise-en-scene and accessible consolidated stage under construction
corpus_routing_contract.classification_law: Observed source wording, semantic claim classification, and authority role remain separate receipt fields; a capture map can locate a claim but cannot be promoted to implementation authority.
corpus_routing_contract.computing_substrate_federation: hardware_profile.html is one non-exclusive, time-scoped host frame inside an open-ended federation of CPU generations, ISAs, firmware, accelerators, compiler stacks, virtual machines and hypervisors, operating environments, networks, storage, and single-/multi-machine deployments.
corpus_routing_contract.discovery_gap_law: Each user-required but not-yet-resolved computing family is a typed Admitted discovery obligation with its own receipt row; it is never silently omitted or presented as Observed implementation evidence.
corpus_routing_contract.publication_navigation_law: Each routed occurrence has exactly one coordinate frame exposing volume, chapter, subsection, semantic drill-down, diagram caption/label route, citation key, occurrence-local source locus, header artifact, footer state, and serialized readback artifact. Citation closure requires bibliography resolution and rendered superscript numeric evidence; an unbound diagram or footer is an explicit GAP.

python_namespace: silmaril.sparky.lambda_blotto avoids reserved-keyword import syntax while preserving Lambda Blotto identity; the shared ByteVector is consumed through Telephone's project dependency gate.

directory_contract.hidden_policy: include-all explicitly includes dot-prefixed entries; exclude-hidden records but does not dispatch them
directory_contract.symlink_policy: child metadata uses follow_symlinks=False and symlinks are recorded but never followed
directory_contract.bounds: maximum entries, maximum depth, file chunk size, and file maximum bytes are explicit request values; an exceeded entry bound cannot yield a complete observed seal
directory_contract.freshness: directory pre/post observations use fstat on the same opened descriptor occurrence and require metadata plus count stability
directory_contract.progress_receipt: every scheduler transition seals scan identity, attempt, transition identity, from/to state, effect, and evidence class with SHA-256
directory_contract.composition: regular-file frontier work advances the file capture scheduler by exactly one transition; child directory work preserves map drilldown and publication routing

provisional_gaps: typed opaque file-description linearity across independent host invocations is unproved
there is no admitted Python interpreter entrance
capture is whole-payload bounded, not a serializable streaming SHA-256 state machine
format evidence is explicit request evidence, not content sniffing
progress is a sealed receipt and emission plan; external wire emission is unbound
os.listdir materializes a whole fresh name vector before one ordinal projection
a serializable kernel-level directory snapshot token is unavailable; same-descriptor metadata and count checks are the admitted bounded substitute
frontier orchestration is external; this slice advances one file or directory state per invocation and has no module-global recursion cursor
Predicted and Counterfactual frames may be evaluated at a current boundary but cannot be sealed as Observed evidence

the computing-substrate federation is permanently open-ended; unresolved Intel/AMD generation, ISA, accelerator/compiler, firmware, VM/hypervisor, network/storage/OS, and deployment families remain typed discovery obligations rather than omissions

directory child lstat metadata is not yet rebound as an equality precondition when separately scheduled file frontier work re-admits the path; replacement is captured as a fresh occurrence rather than proved identical to the parent observation
